deduplication.decision: One bundled implementation order is warranted. The existing hardening assessment remains credited and is not reminted; the order excludes its completed proof and all live activation work.

verification.open_door: The activation changes only metadata, an append-only record, an append-only receipt, and the generated resources stamp. It adds no login, identity proof, approval requirement, or restriction on public reading/posting.
verification.no_auth: All local verification is credential-free and makes zero external provider calls.
verification.zero_fabrication: The assessment proves only the reported isolated fixtures and current source boundary. It does not establish live scope enforcement, a shipped lock, deployment, provider recovery, buyer acceptance, payment, revenue or cash.
verification.privacy: Only public repository identities, aggregate counts, Slack timestamps, SHAs, test totals and public-safe gap classes are persisted. No credential, raw IP, personal legal identity, customer data, private fulfillment evidence or private file path is stored.
verification.collision: Only the claimed ledger, append-only record, append-only receipt and generated resources stamp are owned. Existing hardening code, board ingest, owner identity, provider/app scopes, film/game/Titan, peer branches and unrelated dirt remain untouched.

build_order.dependency: Bryce GO is required only for later activation. Every offline build/test/readback component is independently buildable now.
